title: Cosmic Turtle and Dragon
description: A glowing sea turtle with neon purple and cyan shell patterns swims inside a large transparent bubble, accompanied by a smiling green dragon wearing a golden robe. The scene is set in outer space with vibrant coral, small fish, purple energy bolts, and distant orange planets visible within the bubble against a dark cosmic background.
prompt: A luminous sea turtle with intricate glowing purple and pink shell designs swims gracefully inside a large transparent bubble floating in space. A cheerful green dragon wearing a flowing golden robe rides on the turtle's back. Inside the bubble are vibrant coral reefs, small fish, and swirling purple energy. Two glowing orange planets and stars are visible in the dark cosmic background outside the bubble. Highly detailed fantasy digital art with neon lighting.
